summary: The root كره (krh) signifies dislike, displeasure, or disapproval. It is the opposite of desire, contentment, or love.
lane: 1 كَرِهَهُ ذ [ He disliked, was displeased with, disapproved of, hated, him or it. ] الكَرَاهَةُ is the contr. of الإِرَادَةُ and الرِّضَى . (Marg. note in TA.) -b2- كَرِهَهُ (Mgh, Msb), inf. n. كَرَاهَةٌ and كَرَاهِيَةٌ , (Mgh,) or كُرْهٌ and كَرْهٌ , (Msb,) He did not desire it; he disapproved it, or was displeased or discontented with it; (Mgh;) he disliked it; disapproved it; hated it; contr. of حَبَّهُ . (Msb.) -b3- كَرِهَ and : see سَخِطَ .

headwords.def: [ He disliked, was displeased with, disapproved of, hated, him or it. ] الكَرَاهَةُ is the contr. of الإِرَادَةُ and الرِّضَى. (Marg. note in TA.) كَرِهَهُ (Mgh, Msb), inf. n. كَرَاهَةٌ and كَرَاهِيَةٌ, (Mgh,) or كُرْهٌ and كَرْهٌ, (Msb,) He did not desire it; he disapproved it, or was displeased or discontented with it; (Mgh;) he disliked it; disapproved it; hated it; contr. of حَبَّهُ. (Msb.) كَرِهَ and: see سَخِطَ.
كَرَّهْتُ إِلَيْهِ الشَّىْءَ , inf. n. تَكْرِيهُ, I made the thing to be an object of dislike, disapprobation, or hatred, to him. (S, K. *)
أَكْرَهْتُهُ عَلَى كَدَا I made him to do such a thing against his will. (S.)

He showed, or expressed, dislike, disapprobation, or hatred, of it; see تَاَجَّمَهُ and تَسَخَّطَهُ: and عَليْهِ signifies the same; see قَنَحَ. تَكَرَّهَ He expressed dislike, displeasure, disapprobation, discontent, or hatred. (IbrD.) See examples in the K, voce أَخّْ, and voce أَفّْ, &c. The above is the prevailing signification, and often occurs. تَكَرَّهَهُ i. q. كَرِهَهُ, q. v. (K, * TA.) See also تَأَجَّمَهُ.
Disliked, disapproved of, blamed, or hated; hateful, blameable, displeasing, or odious; as also.
الكَراَهِيَةُ للشَّىْءِ signifies البُغْضُ لَهُ and عَدَمَ مُلَاءَمَتِهِ. (MF in art. ابى.)
Unwilling: see an ex. voce أَسَآءَ.
A thing that one dislikes, disapproves, or hates, or that one dislikes to do: opposed to مَنْشَطٌ: (TA in art. نشط:) [ a thing, or an event, that is an object of dislike or hatred ].

Foul, abominable, or evil; i. q. سَيِّئٌ; (Beyd, xvii. 40;) and شَرٌّ: (TA:) [ held in aversion ]. See كَرِيهٌ. مَكَارِهُ, a pl. of مَكْرُوهٌ. مَكَارِهُ الدَّهْرِ The afflictions, or calamities, of fortune; syn. نَوَازِلُهُ and شَدَائِدُهُ. (TA.) See also مَكْرَهٌ.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
